A protocol change follows the process in [GOVERNANCE.md](../../GOVERNANCE.md): propose in public, review, release. Fill in every section — a reproducible case outweighs an argument.

## The problem

What rule is missing, contradictory or unworkable? Cite the section of [`kungfu.md`](../../kungfu.md).

## The proposed rule

The exact rule you propose, written as it would appear in the text.

## Compatibility

Which kind of change is this under §11 of the protocol — **major**, **minor** or **patch** — and what must existing implementations and stored facts do to keep working?

## How to verify

How a conforming implementation can demonstrate it satisfies the proposed rule (test, invariant, observable behavior).

## Reproducible case

The concrete sequence of events (or the stored facts) where the current text fails or stays silent.
